breakdown.description: Mass/volume conservation is violated for steady incompressible flow in constant area (Q cannot change from inlet to outlet).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly resolved the conservation violation. Instead of accepting the contradictory Q_in = 0.01 and Q_out = 0.02 m³/s, it correctly states 'The volumetric flow rate is 0.01 m³/s at both inlet and outlet' and explains that velocity is constant throughout the pipe due to constant area and incompressible flow, which aligns with the ground truth's use of mass conservation (Q_in = Q_out).
